messages:
alex (CEO): Quick weekly pulse: three high-impact items this week: EU private beta go-live, new default log retention, and a short incident follow-up. I'll keep it brief.

maria (VP Ops): EU private beta is scheduled for Monday 07:00 CET. Cutover checklist in #release-war-room pinned. Ops will monitor for 72h with extended on-call. Expect a short maintenance banner on the Console during the switch.

sam (Head of Product): Product asks: 1) expose retention toggle in Console (default 30d) 2) 'model pin' option for customer-level rollouts (canary -> 10% -> 100%). UX mock is in the drive: /product/designs/private-eu-ui.png.

kevin (Eng Lead): Incident update: last Thursday's spike traced to a scheduling corner in the batcher when cold-start paths raced the rate limiter. PR #5123 adds gating + tests. Canary rolled; full roll at 02:00 UTC tonight. Metrics: 5xxs back to baseline on canary. Added batcher.queue_delay_ms metric and alert at 250ms for 5m.

jena (Security): Policy change: default hosted log retention -> 30 days. If a customer requires >30d we now require a security exemption review and a documented retention justification. KMS rotation policy: 90 days for Private. Please route exemption requests to #security-review.

deploy-bot: deploy bot: Starting canary deployment for eu-private-beta at 2024-11-25T02:00:00Z (sha=7f3b2a).

maria (VP Ops): Action items: ENG: watch canary dashboards and escalate any latency or error regression. PRODUCT: ship retention toggle by Thursday EOD. SUPPORT: tag EU private beta tickets with EU-BETA and triage high. SECURITY: confirm exemption SLA (48h). I'll run a 30m launch sync Friday 09:30 PT.

alex (CEO): Communication note: external message should be two bullets: what changed, how customers are affected (expected downtime/impact). Keep it simple. We'll publish after Friday sync. Thanks team — big push, appreciate the focus. :rocket:
